title: osaa-metrics BSL semantic-model
description: Shape of a Boring Semantic Layer (BSL 0.3.16) YAML for the osaa-metrics pair-analyst MCP. The YAML is parsed to a dict and validated against this schema before BSL's from_config() is invoked. A successful schema check does NOT guarantee the model loads — expression safety and column references in `expr:` strings are checked at runtime by BSL's safe-eval and the server (Phase B/C). This schema covers the structural rules: required fields, allowed shapes, and identifier naming.

model.description: A single BSL semantic-model definition. The top-level key (model name) is the model's identifier; the value is this object.

table.description: Must be the literal string 'core_tbl' — the materialized DuckDB wide table built by save_core_schema + build_core_table. Any other value will fail BSL's from_config().

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the model. Surfaced in summaries to the user.

dimensions.description: Map of dimension name → expression. Names must be unique snake-case identifiers. Each value is either a short-form expression string (e.g. `_.region`) or a long-form object with `expr` and optional `description`. Long-form descriptions surface as chart axis labels.

measures.description: Map of measure name → aggregation expression. Names must be unique snake-case identifiers. Each value is either a short-form expression string (e.g. `_.gdp.sum()`) or a long-form object with `expr` and optional `description`. Long-form descriptions surface as chart axis labels.

dimension.description: Dimension entry: short-form (string) or long-form (object). Short-form is just the expression. Long-form lets you attach a description (used as chart axis labels) and dimension flags.

measure.description: Measure entry: short-form (string) or long-form (object). Short-form is just the expression (e.g. `_.gdp.sum()`). Long-form lets you attach a description.

expression.description: A BSL `_`-expression: attribute access on the deferred placeholder (`_.field`), operators, and method calls (e.g. `_.gdp.sum()`, `_.exports.mean() - _.imports.mean()`). Expression safety is enforced by BSL 0.3.16's safe-eval at load time, which parses each expression and validates it against its own positive AST allowlist — private names/attributes, backend access, IO, and arbitrary calls are rejected there. This schema only checks that the value is a non-empty string.

identifier.description: Snake-case identifier: starts with a lowercase letter or underscore, followed by lowercase letters, digits, or underscores. Same rule as core-table var_names.
